scripts.lint:py: uv run --project bridge --extra dev ruff check
scripts.format:check:py: uv run --project bridge --extra dev ruff format --check
scripts.typecheck:py: uv run --project bridge --extra dev pyright -p bridge
scripts.test:bridge: uv run --project bridge --extra dev pytest -c bridge/pyproject.toml
scripts.check: pnpm lint && pnpm typecheck && pnpm lint:py && pnpm format:check:py && pnpm typecheck:py && pnpm test:bridge
